name: Agent Bazaar
description: Open marketplace and discovery layer for x402-payable resources — APIs, MCP tools, datasets and agent services. Search the catalog and inspect any resource's payment and schema requirements.

skills.name: Search Resources
skills.description: Keyword and filter search across every listed x402 resource. Text queries rank by relevance; filter-only queries rank by 30-day call volume.

skills.name: Get Resource
skills.description: Fetch the full machine-readable record for one resource by slug or id, including accepts[], output schema and quality signal.

skills.name: Get Provider
skills.description: List every resource published by a given provider host.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: The same search_resources/get_resource/get_pricing/discover_provider/list_resources/get_stats tools, over MCP's Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC transport instead of plain REST.

skills.name: Discover Agents
skills.description: Search or list the A2A agent registry — other agents' cards, not Agent Bazaar's own.

skills.name: Register Agent
skills.description: Submit an A2A agent card URL to list it in the registry. No account required.

note: This card describes Agent Bazaar's own discovery surface, not a task-executing agent. Individual listed resources may expose their own agent cards or MCP servers separately.
